cohort: The study included 1083 pregnant women with a GBS-positive culture result from eight European countries.
finding: Among GBS carriers, 13.4% had at least one additional obstetrical risk factor for EOD, 77.8% received IAP (with 49.5% considered appropriate), and nine neonates developed GBS early-onset disease with significant regional heterogeneity.
followup_time: Up to 7 days post-birth (for early-onset disease)
